messages:
elaine-sec: Heads up — saw a ~3x spike in mTLS handshake failures coming from eu-west around the time we rolled the KMS role change. Errors look like AccessDenied during cert unwrap, then downstream tls: handshake error: remote error: bad certificate. anyone seen this pattern?

samir-sre: yep saw it too. tail from proxy logs: `2026-03-20T10:12:03Z proxy[ingress-eu]: tls: handshake error from 10.4.2.9: remote error: bad certificate` followed by KMS client error: `AccessDeniedException: user arn:aws:iam::...:role/redwood-kms-signing-role is not authorized to kms:Decrypt`.

jordan-platform: that lines up with the RBAC tweak we applied to restrict kms:Decrypt on the signing key for non-prod roles at 10:10. I pushed a policy change to deny a few role ARNs, assuming only build jobs used them. Might have been too broad.

elaine-sec: confirmed — the signing service uses that role to unwrap intermediate CA keys for short-lived certs. If unwrap fails, service serves a fallback cert chain that's rejected by clients.

alice-ops: mitigation suggestion: can we add a temporary allow for `redwood-signing-service` principal and roll back after a proper policy? Need quick fix to bring traffic back.

samir-sre: I can open a quick allow ACL in IAM. Shortlived fix: add `kms:Decrypt` for the service principal limited by condition `aws:RequestTag/operation: "cert-unwrap"` and resource with key alias.

jordan-platform: low-friction alternative: point the signing service at the secondary KMS key we use for disaster recovery (already has perms). That avoids policy churn. But requires restart of the signer (10-30s rolling restart).

audit-bot: audit-log: KMS AccessDenied events 10:10:35 -> 10:15:12 UTC for alias/redwood-ca-int-eu. Count=248. Triggered by svc:redwood-signing-service.

elaine-sec: agree with using DR key for now, then do a scoped RBAC rollback. Samir — do the IAM allow if Jordan can't do the DR key switch quick. Alice, can you coordinate the rollout window?

alice-ops: on it — will schedule 2min maintenance window and announce. also enabling verbose TLS debug on proxy for next 30m: `env TLS_DEBUG=1 systemctl reload proxy` so we can see if any clients still fail.

samir-sre: IAM patch ready, applying now with conditional resource limits. will keep it <=15min. posting changes here: ```aws iam put-role-policy --role-name redwood-kms-allow-temp --policy-document '{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789:key/abcd-1234","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:RequestTag/operation":"cert-unwrap"}}}]}'```

jordan-platform: applied DR-key switch for signer in eu-west canary, restarted pod set. curl test: `curl --cert /tmp/cert.pem --key /tmp/key.pem https://svc.eu-west.redwood.internal/health` returns 200 for canary.

elaine-sec: nice. next steps: 1) keep temporary IAM allow for 15m 2) run a full cert issuance smoke across regions 3) audit RBAC diff and create a narrow policy that only allows the signer to decrypt with a condition on tag+kms:ViaService 4) add alert rule for KMS AccessDenied spike (threshold 50/min)

alice-ops: I added the alert in pagerduty (KMS.AccessDenied.Surge). Also filed ticket SEC-5621 for the postmortem and policy follow-up.

samir-sre: rolling back the broad deny now. watchlist up: eu-west proxies health green after 6m.

jordan-platform: cleanup items: rotate intermediate certs issued during the failure window (they may have incomplete chains), and re-run cert validation job: `./scripts/validate-chains --regions all --parallel 8`. I'll take it. ETA 1h.

elaine-sec: assignment recap: Samir = IAM rollback and scoped policy (ETA 15m), Jordan = validate/rotate intermediates (ETA 1h), Alice = outage comms + PD alert (done), Elaine = postmortem writeup + vuln triage (SEC-5621).

elaine-sec: note for postmortem: consider adding guardrails in deploy pipeline to simulate KMS permission matrix for signing before RBAC commits. Also add audit hook that annotates certs with signing-key-id so we can trace quickly next time. :white_check_mark:

alice-ops: all good here, marking thread resolved once Jordan confirms rotate finish. :eyes:
